operations.description: The scan excluded its OWN file but not sibling batch-3 acceptance files, and cluster 7's batch-wide closing table names all nine removed agents by design. The self-reference trap generalised: a test that asserts a name is gone must name it. Exemption widened by exactly one shape -- the batch-3 acceptance suite -- not to tests/ as a whole, which would stop catching a stale agent roster in an ordinary test.

edits.find:
if name == os.path.basename(__file__):
                        # This file names the removed agent throughout, by design.
                        # Batch 2 hit the same self-reference trap.
                        continue
edits.replace:
if name.startswith("test_008_b3c"):
                        # The batch-3 acceptance suite names removed agents by design:
                        # cluster 7's closing table lists all nine. Exactly this one
                        # shape is exempt -- not tests/ as a whole, which would stop
                        # catching a stale agent roster in an ordinary test.
                        continue
